description.value: Sea Dog Farm is a 5-acre certified organic operation in Sidney, BC growing a wide variety of fruits, vegetables, berries, herbs, cut flowers, and free-range eggs. The Centennial Park Farmstand sits at the south end of the property beside a trail in Centennial Park, offering direct farm-to-consumer sales. A live stand cam on the website lets visitors check what is currently stocked before making the trip.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sea Dog Farm operates certified organic farm stands at this location, with the Centennial Park Farmstand explicitly described as being 'at the south end of our property, which falls beside a trail in Centennial Park.' The website front page and Our Story page confirm a wide range of fresh produce for sale. Neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence of bike parking, water access, or most optional amenities beyond the core produce offerings.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on the website; only email (seadogfarm@gmail.com) is available on the shop page.
Street address (1742 Hovey Road) is not explicitly confirmed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active 24/7 farm stand selling fresh certified organic produce beside a Centennial Park trail — a convenient and distinctive resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking local food.

Basic groceries.detail: Website confirms seasonal fruits, vegetables, berries, herbs, cut flowers, and free-range eggs sold directly from the farm stand

wow_evidence: certified organic farm stand… beside a trail in Centennial Park
